title: ID0436475-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002835] Limited charging power
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Limited charging power
Solution:
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-07-04
The same error messages appear every few days and remain for about half a day each time. Then they disappear on their own. During the error, nothing is visible on the charging stations themselves ("ready," status light green), except for the constant, limited charging power of 18.9 kW (fallback?). The frequency: 30% for charging station 7 and 70% for charging station 8. The screenshots are representative of the past two months.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0436475-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002835] Limited charging power CRM:02889000175
additional_info.body:
Dear Ralph Lindner,
Following your report of a power downfall on the SICHARGE D system, we analyzed the charger logs and observed that the ELMS heartbeat was intermittently toggling between offline and online.
This behavior typically indicates unstable communication between the charger and the ELMS, which may have impacted power delivery during the charging session. As a safety precaution, the system may reduce or interrupt charging when a continuous ELMS connection cannot be maintained.
We recommend reviewing the network setup and ELMS connectivity to ensure stable communication.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita
